project.name: Netiquette - GST InvoiceNow S$1k Transition Grant Landing Page
how_to_use: Generate each asset in a NEW Gemini chat, copy the full 'prompt' field as-is.

For consistent style, attach 1-2 screenshots of the existing Netiquette doodle illustrations (e.g. the 'confused woman at monitor' and 'man holding document' images) together with the prompt and say: 'match this illustration style'.
Gemini does not produce real transparency. Generate on pure white background, then remove the background (remove.bg / Photoshop / Canva) for assets marked 'needs_transparent': true.
Do NOT let Gemini draw any official logo (IRAS, IMDA, ACRA, Peppol, Netiquette). Those are placed by HTML on top of blank panels. All prompts already ask for no logos and no text.
Save files with the exact 'filename' into the folder 'assets/img/'. Export as PNG first; I will convert to WebP when building the page.

global_style.style_keywords: hand-drawn doodle illustration, bold black ink outlines with slightly uneven line weight, flat fills, minimal shading, playful editorial style, modern SaaS website illustration
global_style.color_rule: Only black line art + white + blue tones. Gold is allowed ONLY on coins/money elements.
global_style.characters: Diverse Singaporean office workers (Chinese, Malay, Indian), friendly expressive faces, simple cartoon proportions, business-casual clothes in blue
global_style.global_avoid: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no watermark, no photorealism, no 3D render, no gradients, no drop shadows, no purple, no green, no cluttered background

assets.section: Hero (right side, next to headline + eligibility form)
assets.prompt: Hand-drawn doodle illustration in a modern SaaS website style: a cheerful Singaporean small-business owner in a blue shirt sitting at a laptop, pressing a big send button; from the laptop screen a digital invoice document flies out along a curved dotted line toward a stack of gold coins and an open hand receiving them, symbolising a cash grant. Small sparkles and motion lines around. Bold black ink outlines, flat fills in blue (#4A90E2) and light blue (#A9CFF5), gold (#F5B82E) only on the coins, pure white background, generous empty space around the subject. Style: playful editorial doodle, minimal shading. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no 3D, no gradients, no photorealism.
